forecast-period.text: A high pressure system centred south of the Bight extends a ridge across the south of SA. The main high centre will gradually move eastwards to be centred to the east of SA on Friday. A trough over the interior of WA will remain stationary for most of the week and may extend into the far west of SA at times. Another low pressure trough will approach from the west on Saturday and move across SA on Sunday.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Cold at first about central and eastern parts with patchy morning frost. Dry apart from isolated showers and thunderstorms in the far west. Maximum temperatures above average in the far northeast but below average elsewhere. Southeast to northeasterly winds, fresh at times near the coast and in the north.
Showers in the west, extending into the far west of the North East Pastoral at times. Isolated thunderstorms in the far northwest. Dry elsewhere. Southeasterly winds, fresh at times.

Patchy morning fog about eastern districts. Dry apart from isolated showers in the west and isolated thunderstorms in the far west. Maximum temperatures slightly below average about coastal districts but above average further inland. East to northeasterly winds, tending east to southeasterly in the northeast.

Dry apart from the chance of a shower or thunderstorm in the far southwest in the evening. Maximum temperatures above average. Northeast to northerly winds, tending east to southeasterly in the northeast.

text.p: Showers and isolated thunderstorms extending across the south, clearing from the west by early afternoon. Maximum temperatures above average. North to northwesterly winds, shifting southwest to southeasterly from the west.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Sunday: less than 2 mm about the agricultural area, although local falls of 2 to 5 mm are possible with Sunday's change. 5 to 15 mm is likely over areas west of about Ceduna, but local heavier falls of 15 to 30 mm are possible in the west of the North West Pastoral district. Less than 2 mm is likely in the far southeast of the North West Pastoral. Falls of 2 to 5 mm are possible over the remainder of the North West Pastoral and in the far west of the North East Pastoral district.
